preconditions: Owned temporary current projects. Recorded-build unit fixtures are explicitly synthetic; a separate isolated integration uses actual generated module and ZIP distributions. Cache files are explicitly installed by the fixture, never by the read-only product API.
steps: Compare complete incoming, outgoing and combined relation views for every artifact against the independent fresh scan, including isolated sources.
Exercise missing/deleted/stale/malformed entries, binding substitutions and rehashed invalid adjacency; compare exact results and unchanged project file bytes.
Verify original-source failures still propagate and actual module/ZIP builds reuse a validated cache without normal adjacency reconstruction.

oracle.requirement_contract: Fehlende oder gelöschte persistente Caches DÜRFEN NICHT die fachliche Ausführbarkeit eines zulässigen Auftrags verhindern.
oracle.scope: Existing current-project relation reader only: off, a real validated hit, missing or deleted cache and complete rebuild return the same fresh data. No directories are created and original input failures remain failures.

open_items: Partial current-project relation-reader integration only. Native permission/resource/race hardening follows 6.g.R. CLI-wide cache selection, other cache kinds, adaptive CPU/memory accounting and persistent Work continuation, full runtime/platform acceptance and performance benchmarks remain open. Full parsed cache objects can exceed the read-byte allowance in memory; that allowance is not an RSS cap.
